limitations: Small constant-position GPU fixtures intentionally remove output dependence on new random seeds. Each image has one small nonuniform point footprint and a mostly uniform background; these do not test arbitrary formulas, complex geometry or random stream identity.
Parameter fixtures multiply lambda/a/b by zero to keep the point position fixed: parameter checks prove author/effective transport and owner lifecycle, not visual sensitivity to those parameters.
Canvas comparison follows the declared opaque-rgb-copy presentation: target RGB is preserved and canvas alpha is 255; target PNG alpha is not claimed equal.
Local reference uses a separately parsed source document and fresh production runtime without UI generator state. It is a boundary-equivalence check, not an independent original image oracle.
Original JVM, desktop windows, recording, original whole-frame/animation parity and platform packaging are not executed.
Sampled process-family CPU/RSS include observers and browser/service costs; no before/after cold/warm performance, GPU/VRAM or token comparison.
